models_evaluated: AI-based surgical video assessment platform (AI-derived appendicitis severity score)

links.outcome: Model discrimination (AUC), calibration and decision curve net benefit for predicting complications
links.effect: AI severity AUC 0.63 vs operative-AAST 0.68; calibration acceptable at extremes and improved at intermediate risk; DCA highest net benefit at intermediate risk.
links.quote: Discrimination was modest (AUC = 0.63), similar to operative-AAST (AUC = 0.68).

links.outcome: AI-derived severity compared with operative-AAST grading for predicting complications
links.effect: AI OR 2.76 (95% CI 1.62-4.73); after AAST adjustment OR 1.90 (1.07-3.36); AUC 0.63 vs 0.68; net benefit comparable or higher than AAST.
links.quote: AI-derived severity independently predicted complications (OR 2.76, 95% CI 1.62-4.73; p < 0.001), even after adjustment for operative-AAST (OR 1.90, 95% CI 1.07-3.36; p = 0.028).

screen.reason: Retrospective study evaluating the clinical predictive value and decision curves of an automated AI surgical video assessment tool for post-appendectomy complications.
